relations: The descending steel ram progressively occludes the yellow-and-black striped cylinder inside the crumpled gray housing.
Downward pressure from the ram forces the folded left and right housing flaps to tilt outward.
The front panel with circular cut-outs shifts in frame as the ram continues its steady descent.
The visible striped band narrows to a thin rim as the ram's lower section sinks deeper.
caption: The video showcases a polished steel hydraulic-press ram, a stepped cylinder, bearing down into a gray metal housing whose side walls are folded and crumpled. Inside it sits a yellow-and-black hazard-striped cylinder that the ram presses upon, resting on a red workbench against a white wall and a red-and-black machine frame. The ram descends steadily, the step between its wider upper and narrower lower sections sinking from just above the housing rim to deep within the crumpled walls. The visible portion of the striped band shrinks beneath the ram, narrowing to a thin yellow rim as the metal cylinder occludes it. The folded left and right flaps tilt outward under the load while the front panel with circular cut-outs shifts in frame. The band's hue darkens toward orange in the later moments, and the background drifts subtly, indicating movement of the camera or assembly. The descent continues without pause, the ram pressing deeper into the crumpled housing.
